item.title: Supreme Court Has Struck Down Trump Tariffs; Where Does That Leave Cars?
item.description: In a 6-3 vote, the Supreme Court ruled that the president exceeded his authority with widespread tariffs based on an emergency powers law. We examine the impact on the auto industry and car shoppers.

item.title: Base Tesla Cybertruck Costs $20K Less Without Losing Performance
item.description: The new Dual Motor All-Wheel Drive model starts at $62,235 and skips out on interior goodies such as ventilated seats and a rear passenger screen.

item.description: The Lexus IS, which cheated death for the 2026 model year, could come back as an EV in 2027.
